items.markdown:
Essential Thailand travel advice includes `entry requirements, local laws, and health precautions` . British passport holders can visit visa-free for up to 60 days, must carry a valid passport at all times, and must complete the online digital arrival card before flying.[](https://www.tui.co.uk/destinations/asia/thailand/holidays-thailand/travel-advice) [[1]](https://www.tui.co.uk/destinations/asia/thailand/holidays-thailand/travel-advice)[[2]](https://www.gov.uk/foreign-travel-advice/thailand)[[3]](https://fanclubthailand.co.uk/thailand-travel-advice/)[[4]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TTUKoMfT7-M&t=488)

Safety and Legal Rules

- **Cannabis Laws:** Recreational cannabis use is banned and illegal; it is only allowed for medical purposes with a prescription. Exporting cannabis out of the country is a serious offense leading to arrest or fines.[[1]](https://www.liverpoolecho.co.uk/news/uk-world-news/thailand-travel-advice-update-after-34219298)
- **Vaping Ban:** E-cigarettes and vaping devices are strictly illegal to possess, use, or import in Thailand.[](https://fanclubthailand.co.uk/thailand-travel-advice/) [[1]](https://fanclubthailand.co.uk/thailand-travel-advice/)
- **Restricted Areas:** Avoid all non-essential travel to the deep southern provinces near the Malaysia border (Pattani, Yala, Narathiwat, and parts of Songkhla) due to ongoing security risks.[](https://www.gov.uk/foreign-travel-advice/thailand) [[1]](https://www.gov.uk/foreign-travel-advice/thailand)[[2]](https://www.ireland.ie/en/dfa/overseas-travel/advice/thailand/)
- **Royal Insult:** Never speak negatively or make jokes about the royal family, as strict lèse-majesté laws carry heavy prison terms.[](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TTUKoMfT7-M&t=488) [[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TTUKoMfT7-M&t=488)[[2]](https://www.travelbeginsat40.com/travel-guide/thailand-travel/)[[3]](https://blog.onevasco.com/things-not-to-do-while-traveling/thailand)

Health and Climate

- **Water Safety:** Do not drink tap water; use bottled water for drinking and brushing teeth.[](https://www.responsibletravel.com/holidays/thailand/travel-guide/thailand-travel-advice) [[1]](https://www.responsibletravel.com/holidays/thailand/travel-guide/thailand-travel-advice)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iUpSB646_oQ&t=507)
- **Vaccines & Mosquitos:** Recommended routine vaccines include Tetanus, Hepatitis A, and Typhoid. Protect yourself against mosquito bites using strong insect repellent to prevent Dengue fever.[](https://www.responsibletravel.com/holidays/thailand/travel-guide/thailand-travel-advice) [[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aFENusFiJX4&t=571)[[2]](https://theroamingrenegades.com/thailand-travel-tips/)
- **Best Time to Visit:** The ideal dry and cool weather occurs between November and April. The heavy monsoon rainy season runs from May to October.[](https://www.tui.co.uk/destinations/asia/thailand/holidays-thailand/travel-advice) [[1]](https://www.traveltalktours.com/thailand-travel-advice/)[[2]](https://embassies.gov.il/thailand/en/the-embassy/information)[[3]](https://threeland.com/blogs/from-usa-to-thailand-the-ultimate-travel-guide)

Cultural Etiquette

- **Temples and Dress:** Dress modestly at religious sites by covering your shoulders and knees. Always remove your shoes before entering a temple or a Thai home.[](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TTUKoMfT7-M&t=488) [[1]](https://www.thaizer.com/mind-your-feet/)
- **Body Gestures:** Do not touch anyone on the head or point your feet at people or sacred religious objects, as these parts of the body are culturally viewed as the highest and lowest points respectively.[](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TTUKoMfT7-M&t=488) [[1]](https://www.onthegotours.com/Thailand/Guides/Travel-Tips-and-Useful-Info)[[2]](https://www.bookmundi.com/y/thailand)
